summaryPeakCeHelp: Maximum effect-site concentration (Ce) reached during the simulation and the time it occurred. The @time is **minutes from simulation start**. Peak Ce is the closest single-number proxy for maximum PD effect (depth of analgesia / respiratory depression).
summaryOnsetHelp: Minute (from sim start) when Ce first crossed this drug's **analgesic lower threshold** ('Ce ≥ x.x' shown below). Before this time, analgesia is judged insufficient. The threshold itself comes from the literature-backed range.
summaryBisOnsetHelp: Minute (from sim start) when Ce first crossed the sedative's **BIS target lower bound** — i.e. when clinically meaningful sedation begins.
summaryRespRiskHelp: **Cumulative time (minutes)** spent above the respiratory C50. The right-axis depression curve is the instantaneous picture (Hill γ=1); this card is the cumulative dwell-time in the risk zone.
summaryDeepSedationHelp: Cumulative time (minutes) spent in the **deep-sedation Ce zone** for this sedative (BIS<40-equivalent or equivalent depth marker).
summaryRecoveryHelp: Predicted minutes from the **final infusion-stop** until Ce drops back below the analgesic lower threshold. Real awakening may use a different threshold — treat as guidance, not target.
summaryTotalDoseHelp: **Total drug delivered** over the simulated window (bolus sum + infusion × duration). Unit is shown on the card. Useful for sanity-checking against actual dosing records.
alertsStable: 🛡 No flags in the current simulation.
alertsDisclaimer: These alerts interpret the same numbers shown above and are advisory only. Final decisions belong at the bedside.
alertSustainedRespBody: Ce above the respiratory C50 ({{threshold}} ng/mL) for {{minutes}} consecutive min. Consider stopping infusion, escalating monitoring, having naloxone ready.
alertSevereDepressionBody: Hill-transformed Σ(Ce/respC50) predicts about {{fraction}}% ventilatory depression at minute {{at}}. Typical for multi-opioid co-administration — plan reversal and consider controlled ventilation.
alertUndertreatmentBody: Peak Ce only reached {{peak}} ng/mL — below the analgesic lower bound of {{threshold}} ng/mL. Consider re-evaluating the dose.
alertInvertedWindowBody: Analgesia lower bound {{analgesia}} ng/mL sits above the respiratory C50 ({{resp}} ng/mL). Respiratory depression starts before analgesia — titrate cautiously and monitor ventilation.
alertWaningBody: Ce has been below the analgesic lower bound for {{sinceMin}} minutes. Pain may return — re-evaluate the need for an additional dose.
sedationAdvancedCeNote: Ce derived from {{source}} (ke0 = {{ke0}}/min). Exploratory PKPD — not for clinical dosing decisions.
sedationCeUnavailableReason: Effect-site model not implemented for this drug — PD endpoints (analgesia, sedation, dissociation, EEG, hemodynamics) have endpoint-specific concentration-effect relationships and no single ke0 captures all clinical effects.
dexContextWarning: Dexmedetomidine sedation is highly context-dependent — arousal, stimulation, co-administered drugs, age, hepatic/cardiac function, and ICU illness substantially alter the clinical effect.
ketamineContextWarning: S-ketamine PK only (Noppers 2011) — racemic ketamine is not modelled; do not interpret these concentrations as total racemic ketamine. Ce intentionally not shown — see Ce N/A note for why.
ketamineHeatPainRef: Heat-pain C50 ~375 ng/mL (Sigtermans/Noppers, experimental — not a sedation/anesthesia threshold)
chartClassTooltip: Switch which drug class the main chart renders. Auto-estimated from active drugs; clicking either side records a manual override. Use the toggle to view one class at a time when both are in use.
burdenTooltip: Right-axis dashed curve = **instantaneous** fractional respiratory depression R/(1+R), where R = Σ(Ce/RespC50) summed over active opioids (Hill γ=1). 0.5 = 50% depression (single drug at its respC50, by C50 definition). Based on Dahan 2004 (γ ≈ 1 for hypercapnic/hypoxic respiration) and competitive μ-opioid receptor binding. **Separate from** the cumulative AUC panel below. Total AUC = ∫Ce dt; Therapeutic AUC counts exposure within the analgesic band; Supratherapeutic is the area above the upper analgesic threshold.
xAxisMinTooltip: X-axis lower bound (minutes from sim start)
resetDisplayTooltip: Reset axes / time-zero / display modes to defaults (events and patient unchanged)
viewLiteratureTooltip: Show literature references for this drug's therapeutic range
noReferenceData: No literature reference data available for this drug.
provisionalWarning: Some Ce values for this drug are extrapolated or inferred — primary literature with abstract-level Ce50 was not located. Treat numeric ranges as guidance, not precision.
